title: Ramen steam macro
idea: macro shot of a bowl of ramen as chopsticks lift the noodles
subject: a bowl of tonkotsu ramen with a soft egg, chopsticks lifting noodles
setting: a dark wooden counter in a small ramen shop
lens: 100mm macro, f/4, shallow depth of field
light: warm pendant lamp as key from above, steam backlit

beats.action: steam rises off the broth, chopsticks dip in
the chopsticks lift a tangle of noodles, broth dripping
beats.camera: slow tilt up following the noodles

beats.action: the noodles hang and drip; steam curls through the light

physics: steam rises and curls; broth drips at real speed; noodles sag with weight
